description: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human dates in UTC and local time, and dates back to timestamps.

faqs.a: Any value of 1,000,000,000,000 or more is treated as milliseconds; smaller values are treated as seconds. This is correct for all real-world dates.
faqs.q: How does it tell seconds from milliseconds?

faqs.a: Your browser's timezone. The UTC and ISO 8601 outputs are timezone-independent.
faqs.q: Which timezone is the local time in?

faqs.a: No — only non-negative timestamps are accepted.

howto: Paste a Unix timestamp to see the date in UTC, your local timezone and ISO format.
Or pick a date and time to get its timestamp in seconds and milliseconds.
Seconds and milliseconds are auto-detected by magnitude.
Use the “Use now” button for the current timestamp.
title: Unix Timestamp Converter
